message: config/security.yaml does not match depcurfew.json: `dangerouslyAllowAllBuilds: true` should be `dangerouslyAllowAllBuilds: false`
fix: Run depcurfew apply to bring config/security.yaml back in line with depcurfew.json (depcurfew apply --dry-run shows the change first), or change depcurfew.json if the edit was intended
